name: empty-state-01
title: Empty State 01 - The Three Reasons A Region Is Empty
description: The state a region shows when it has nothing in it: a dashed frame, the caller's headline and sentence, a mark of the caller's choosing, and at most one action. The required reason prop distinguishes a first run from a filter that matched nothing from a permission boundary, because those three want different words and different actions. Every string is passed in as a prop.
